newsitem.title: USA: TYPHOON CONTINUES TO WEAKEN IN EAST CHINA SEA - WSC.
newsitem.headline: TYPHOON CONTINUES TO WEAKEN IN EAST CHINA SEA - WSC.

text.p: Typhoon Tina continues to weaken while moving northward in the East China Sea, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Thursday.
Tina passed just west of Okinawa, producing heavy rain and wind gusts to near 90 mph.
But it is weakening and is only expected to be a tropical storm when it reaches southern Korea in about 48 hours, WSC said. Tina may produce minor to moderate damage from wind and rain in Korea.
